name: easycaptionkit
description: Burn captions into a video in the product's own fonts and colors, word by word or line by line, kept clear of each app's buttons, with SRT, VTT and ASS files.

interface.longDescription: Burns captions into a video from words with times (a speech-to-text JSON from OpenAI, whisper.cpp, WhisperX, ElevenLabs, Deepgram and others, an SRT or VTT file, or a demo's steps), word by word or line by line, in the fonts and colors of the product's own site, kept clear of the buttons TikTok, Reels, Shorts, YouTube, X and LinkedIn put over a video. Writes captioned.mp4 with captions.srt, captions.vtt and captions.ass. Needs Node 22 or newer, ffmpeg 4.4 or newer and Chrome, and no API key.
defaultPrompt: Caption demo.mp4 for TikTok and Reels from transcript.json
